name: work-management
description: Fourteen complete focus, planning, handoff, host exchange, GitHub and vault workflows with original helpers. Originating profile, host/account maps and private history are replaced by recipient templates; hooks remain opt-in.

interface.shortDescription: Focus, requirements, structure and parallel work
interface.longDescription: Turn a competing set of ideas or a complex assignment into a concrete deliverable, choose the right tools, and carry work through verified handoff. Choose the next useful outcome and keep scope from expanding. Define a feature, locate its owning project, or delegate a bounded piece of work. Review selected evidence, maintain plugins, or hand over work with its actual completion state. Start with a concrete task or ask what this plugin can do. The plugin supplies methods, selected local helpers and bounded hooks. Native host tools own goals/chats/automations; a request to plan or draft does not authorize sending or publishing. Public edition registers full optional hook code; the host's native enable/trust/settings step still governs activation.
defaultPrompt: Turn this idea into a buildable feature.
Help me finish the most useful next deliverable.
